Methodology: how this is worked out

How the phases connect

Analysis flow, Phase 3 to Phase 10

Phase 3POC efficiency KPI from the historian export.

Phase 6KPI-derived abnormal periods.

Phase 7Empirical POC risk score, relative to the Apr–May reference.

Phase 8Historical validation of the score against those periods.

Phase 9Read-only API over the frozen results, plus the plant annotation store.

Phase 10This dashboard. It draws served results and recalculates nothing.

Analytical boundary

An empirical proof of concept

not a validated plant-event detector

does not anticipate plant events

does not raise warnings or alarms

not a source of process or set-point advice

Risk score

empirical POC risk score (0-100): risk_score = 100 * (0.5 * H + 0.25 * C + 0.25 * P): magnitude H, concurrence C and persistence P of per-family deviations from the frozen Apr-May reference.

Reference window 2025-04-01 00:00 to 2025-05-31 23:59 (7,774 buckets). Score version p7-risk-1.1.0.

Bands: reference-relative quantile bands of the Apr-May reference; not plant limits, alarm levels or action thresholds. They are shown here as text only and are never painted on a chart as limits.

Retrospective empirical POC risk score: resemblance to abnormal process conditions relative to the Apr-May 2025 reference. It is not a prediction, an alert, or a deposit / ring / failure probability, and not an early warning.

KPI-derived abnormal periods (not plant events)

Definition: RUNNING buckets with Phase 3 KPI >= frozen training P90, merged across gaps <= 60 min; final set = out of sample, no ordinary-context rule, >= 1 family above its training P90.

KPI-derived empirical abnormal periods from the Phase 3 POC KPI. They are not plant events, incidents, deposits, rings or failures.

Historical validation

Protocol: frozen pre-declared protocol; primary endpoint = median rank excess over (T0 - 60 min, T0] vs month-matched ordinary running.

Historical validation results only. Phase 8 did not support an early-warning claim against the KPI-derived abnormal periods. Nothing here is a live warning.

O₂-excluded variant

Phase 7 EXCLUDE_KILN_INLET_O2_ANALYSER variant as evaluated by Phase 8 (COMBUSTION / STABILITY rebuilt without Kiln-I!X).

Sensitivity analysis only: the Phase 8 O2-excluded validation variant (Kiln-I!X removed). It does not replace the primary score and is not preferred.

Plant annotations

Plant event annotations are plant-supplied ground-truth candidates. They are never generated from the risk score or the KPI-derived periods.

Annotations are saved through the analysis service with the actor's name as attribution, and every change is kept in an audit trail. A KPI-derived period that overlaps an annotation is listed as context, never as a detection.

Data and timestamps

Source window 2025-04-01..2025-09-30; operational scoring 2025-06-01..2025-08-23; reference 2025-04-01..2025-05-31 (Phase 7 frozen reference, in-sample).

timezone-naive historian export (no timezone supplied; plant question open). Scores are 10-min buckets labelled by bucket end: a row at T covers (T - 10 min, T]. Timestamps are served exactly as stored, never converted, resampled or filled.

Dashboard: reads served results only · API p9-api-1.0.0

The score is reference-relative

There is no plant ground truth

No coating, ring, deposit, cleaning, maintenance or stoppage-reason records exist in the supplied data. Detection, risk and early-warning claims cannot be validated against plant events.
